tasks.title: Review and Ensure Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Review and verify mobile responsive design across all calculator components:

1. Read existing responsive CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css (check media queries for mobile/tablet/desktop)
   - src/components/Display.css (verify font scaling and padding)
   - src/components/Button.css (ensure touch-friendly sizing)

2. Verify and enhance responsive breakpoints:
   - Mobile: max-width 480px (minimum)
   - Tablet: 481px to 768px
   - Desktop: 769px and above

3. Ensure components are touch-friendly:
   - Button minimum size 44x44px for touch targets
   - Adequate spacing between interactive elements
   - Display text scales appropriately

4. Write/update tests:
   - Add responsive behavior tests to existing test files
   - Verify component rendering at different viewport sizes
   - Test touch interaction handling

5. Reference existing test patterns:
   - src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
   - src/components/Display.test.tsx
   - src/components/Button.test.tsx
acceptance_criteria: All CSS files have appropriate media queries for mobile, tablet, desktop
Touch targets meet minimum 44x44px size requirement
Components render correctly at 375px, 768px, and 1920px widths
No horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsive Design
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive across all device sizes:

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially responsive-related tests

2. Visual validation with screenshots:
   - Start dev server: npm run dev
   - Capture screenshots at multiple viewport sizes:
     * Mobile (375x667 - iPhone SE)
     * Mobile (414x896 - iPhone 11 Pro Max)
     * Tablet (768x1024 - iPad)
     * Desktop (1920x1080)
   - Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/

3. Verify responsive behavior:
   - No horizontal scrolling at any viewport size
   - All buttons are touch-friendly (minimum 44x44px)
   - Text is readable at all sizes
   - Layout adapts appropriately to screen size
   - Calculator remains centered and properly sized

4. Stop dev server after validation
acceptance_criteria: Screenshots captured for mobile, tablet, desktop viewports
No layout issues visible in screenshots
Calculator is usable on all tested viewport sizes
